title: 第十八章 就这？
content_zh: 但方彻怎么会让她暴露？哪怕真的暴露了也要给她圆过去。于是正在夜梦不知所措的时候，只听见方彻在外面不耐烦的声音。“洗完了赶紧出来打扫一下院子和书房，我和母亲去家族中一趟；你自己干啊，别想着让人帮忙，秋雪和冬梅都出去有事情，你快些！”方彻哼了一声，在外面道：“娘，我们走。”方浅意的声音：“好的……彻儿，夜梦身体才刚刚开始恢复，不要太过苛责……”声音慢慢远去。夜梦的一颗心顿时稳定下来。都走了，真是天赐良机，赶紧突破！赶紧服下一颗敛息丹，稍稍遮掩一下突破气息，虽然效果有限，却也聊胜于无。出乎她预料，一直到她突破完毕，重新洗了个澡，打扫完院子和书房，天色都黑了，方彻一家居然还都没回来。一直到了烛光燃起，秋雪和冬梅才赶着马车回来，指挥人往家里搬一个一个的大箱子。然后方彻和方浅意才一脸疲倦的回来，随即方家就送来了两桌饭食。看来忙了一下午半晚上，没来得及吃饭。……方家的家族部署已经完成，在得到了原本苏家的部分势力范围和商圈范围之后，整个家族发展已经具备了强实的基础。方正航召集众人开会，安排部署下一步家族计划。“首先，武力配置，必须要上一步！现在家族修为最高的，才只是大宗师级别；这不行，只凭着现在的实力，想要冲击八级，毫无希望。甚至在九级中，也依然存在掉级的风险。”“毕竟除了庇护民众，照顾民生，方便社会之外，作为世家，最重要的是完成镇守大殿的任务，交出符合九级世家的贡献，拿到贡献点，并且合格。才是最重要的。”“毕竟上面这些，有各级官府，还有天下商人，只要货物流通，民众生活便能保障，没有世家，也无所谓。”“而世家所需要交上的贡献点，一是抓捕各类逃犯，以及危害民众和社会的人。二来就是上交妖兽晶核，扫除荒野威胁；三来便是铲除邪教妖人。”“也只有这三点才能换取贡献点。”“而这三点，每一样都需要强横武力。所以武力修为，必须是重中之重。”整个家族高层都是面沉如水。人人心中沉重。去年一年，九级家族贡献点二百。而家族完成了二百一十五点，堪堪保级。今年已经过去了半年，贡献点只获得了九十八点。距离完成全年任务，遥遥无期。“现在武道大宗师两位……”方正航叹了口气。便在这时，方浅意弱弱的举手。“我……”“你怎么？”“我估计这個月，就可以突破先天大宗师了。”方浅意道。她也不知道怎么回事，自从半月之前，回家和儿子吃了一顿饭之后，修为突飞猛涨，简直恐怖。资质也变强了许多。吸收灵气的速度，是之前的数倍以上。虽然隐隐猜测可能是儿子给自己吃的果子的原因，但是方浅意并没有说。也没有问。这种事，太敏感。一旦暴露，只是本家族中人的觊觎与渴望，就无法处理。因为那种东西绝不可能太多。“你快要突破了？”方正航大喜过望，房内其他人也都是神情一震，露出狂喜的神色。这实在是天大的好消息。多一个大宗师，对于完成镇守大殿的任务，又多了几分把握。“恩，估计不到下月，就能突破，这几天已经有了感觉。”方浅意笑道。“那就好，太好了！”方正航大喜过望。方彻坐在母亲身后，淡淡开口：“至于妖兽晶核，我那里还有些，都是苏越大哥家族留下的财产，还有几百枚；虽然品质参差不齐，不过也都可以顶任务，家族可以使用，只需要把钱给我就好了。不过我希望把任务名额放在我娘的名下。”“那就更好了！放在你娘名下更加没问题，反正都是我们盯着咱们家族名字完成的任务。”方正航更加高兴。给镇守大殿交任务晶核，镇守大殿收取算了贡献点之后，每一枚晶核，也以市价七成的价格收购。是有钱的。方家要了任务和贡献点，方彻收了钱放进‘苏家财产’，各取所需。反正苏家也不需要交任务了。“这样一来，二三百枚的话，差不多有将近四十点贡献点，那我们全年任务，就顿时轻松了许多。”众人喜笑颜开。“还是不能放松，这贡献点，越多越好！”方正航严重告诫。众人满口答应，但一个个脸上神情，都有些轻松。毕竟，提前完成任务，与压着时间线完成任务，那是不同的心情，也是不同的风险。如果到了最后一个月还不能完成，那么，整个家族的人都要拼命，伤亡必不可免啊。开会开了许久。方彻全程陪同。方浅意感觉很奇怪，之前儿子从来不参加的，这次怎么这么耐得住性子。居然一直坐到了散会。“你咋了？脑子没问题吧？”方浅意担心的摸了摸儿子额头，不热啊。方彻一脸无奈的拿掉了母亲的手。自从重生以来快一个月了。自从那天晚上看到母亲方浅意，方彻总有一种奇特的感觉。总感觉和方浅意在一起聊天也好做事也好，有一种和当年的兄弟们在一起的那种感觉，很是粗豪的江湖感觉。很爽快，很直，很憨。根本没有半点那种普通女儿家的娇气，连细腻也谈不上，大大咧咧。相处十分舒服。“我那老爹是祖坟上冒青烟了，才能找到这么好的媳妇。”方彻心里羡慕。跟方浅意在一起，极少有母亲照顾儿子的感觉，反而是方彻在包容着照顾着母亲。而且还有一种“照顾不大懂事的妹妹”和“照顾女儿”的感觉。这就很奇。
content_en: But how could Fang Che expose her?Even if he is really exposed, he must make it right for her.So when Ye Meng was at a loss, he only heard Fang Che's impatient voice outside."After washing, hurry up and clean the yard and study. My mother and I will go to the family; do it by yourself, don't think about asking for help. Qiu Xue and Dong Mei are both out for business, hurry up!" Fang Che snorted and said outside: "Mom, let's go." Fang Qianyi's voice: "Okay... Che'er, Ye Meng's body has just begun to recover, don't be too harsh..." The voice slowly faded away.Ye Meng's heart suddenly stabilized.They're all gone. It's a God-given opportunity. Hurry up and break through!He quickly took a Breath-Condensing Pill to slightly cover up his breakthrough aura. Although the effect was limited, it was better than nothing.To her surprise, until she finished her breakthrough, took a shower again, and cleaned the yard and study, it was getting dark, and Fang Che's family still hadn't come back.It wasn't until the candlelight was lit that Qiuxue and Dongmei drove the carriage back and ordered people to move large boxes home one by one.Then Fang Che and Fang Qianyi came back with tired faces, and then the Fang family sent two tables of meals.It seems that I was busy all afternoon and half of the evening and didn't have time to eat....The Fang family's family deployment has been completed. After obtaining part of the original Su family's sphere of influence and business district, the entire family has a strong foundation for development.Fang Zhenghang convened a meeting to arrange and deploy the next family plan."First of all, we must take a step forward in the allocation of force! Now the highest cultivation level in the family is only at the Grand Master level; this is not possible. If you want to reach the eighth level with just your current strength, there is no hope. Even in the ninth level, there is still the risk of falling." "Complete.In addition to protecting the people, taking care of people's livelihood, and making society more convenient, as a family, the most important thing is to complete the task of guarding the palace, make contributions that are in line with the ninth-level family, and get the contribution points and pass the test.""After all, there are all levels of the above.The government, as well as the merchants all over the world, can ensure people's lives as long as goods circulate, and it doesn't matter if they don't have aristocratic families."The contribution points that aristocratic families need to make are, firstly, to capture all kinds of fugitives and those who endanger the people and society. Secondly, they need to hand over the monster crystal cores.", wipe out the threats in the wilderness;the third is to eradicate the evil cult."" Only these three points can be exchanged for contribution points.Therefore, the cultivation of force must be the top priority.Everyone's heart is heavy.Last year, the ninth-level family contributed 200 points.The family has completed 215 points and is worthy of relegation.Half a year has passed this year, and only ninety-eight contribution points have been obtained.We are still far away from completing the full year's tasks."Now there are two great martial arts masters..." Fang Zhenghang sighed.At this moment, Fang Qianyi weakly raised his hand."I..." "What's wrong with you?" "I estimate that within this month, I will be able to break through to the Innate Grand Master." Fang Qianyi said.She didn't know what was going on, but since she went home and had a meal with her son half a month ago, her cultivation level had skyrocketed, which was simply terrifying.The qualifications have also become much stronger.The speed of absorbing spiritual energy is several times higher than before.Although there was a vague guess that it might be the reason why his son gave him the fruit to eat, Fang Qianyi did not say anything.Didn't ask.This kind of thing is too sensitive.Once exposed, it is just the covetousness and desire of people in this family, which cannot be dealt with.Because you can never have too much of that kind of thing."Are you about to make a breakthrough?" Fang Zhenghang was overjoyed, and everyone else in the room also looked shocked, showing expressions of ecstasy.This is really great news.With one more Grand Master, he would be a little more sure of completing the task of guarding the main hall."Well, I estimate that we will be able to break through within the next month. I have already felt it in the past few days." Fang Qianyi said with a smile."That's good, great!" Fang Zhenghang was overjoyed.Fang Che sat behind his mother and said calmly: "As for the monster crystal cores, I still have some there. They are the property left by Brother Su's family. There are still a few hundred pieces. Although the quality varies, they can all be used for tasks. The family can use them, just give me the money. But I hope the task quota will be in my mother's name." "That would be better! It is even better to put it in your mother's name. Anyway, we are completing the tasks based on our family's name." Fang Zhenghang was even more happy.Submit mission crystal cores to the guard hall. After the guard hall collects contribution points, each crystal core will be purchased at 70% of the market price.Be rich.The Fang family asked for tasks and contribution points, and Fang Che collected the money and put it into the "Su family property", each getting what they needed.Anyway, the Su family doesn’t need to hand in tasks."In this way, if we spend two to three hundred coins, we will have almost forty contribution points. Then our tasks for the whole year will be much easier." Everyone smiled happily."Still can't relax. The more contribution points, the better!" Fang Zhenghang warned seriously.Everyone agreed, but the expressions on their faces were a little relaxed.After all, completing a task ahead of schedule is a different mood and carries different risks than completing a task against a timeline.If it cannot be completed in the last month, then the entire family will have to work hard, and casualties will be inevitable.The meeting lasted for a long time.Fang Che accompanied the whole process.Fang Qianyi felt strange. His son had never participated before, so how could he be so patient this time?He actually sat there until the meeting ended."What's wrong with you? Is your brain okay?" Fang Qianyi worriedly touched her son's forehead. It wasn't hot.Fang Che took off his mother's hand with a look of helplessness.It has been almost a month since my rebirth.Ever since seeing his mother Fang Qianyi that night, Fang Che always had a strange feeling.I always feel that when I am chatting or doing things with Fang Qianyi, I have the same feeling as being with my brothers from back then, a very rough world feeling.Very refreshing, very straightforward and very naive.There is no trace of the squeamishness of an ordinary daughter's family, not even delicate, carefree.Very comfortable to get along with."My father had to smoke from his ancestral grave to find such a good wife." Fang Che was envious in his heart.When I'm with Fang Qianyi, I rarely feel like a mother is taking care of her son. Instead, Fang Che is tolerant and caring for my mother.There is also a feeling of "taking care of a less sensible sister" and "taking care of a daughter".This is very strange.
